name: web-gradient-background-frosted-glass-panel-orange-purple-template
title: 'Gradient Background' template with a frosted glass panel over a vivid orange-purple blurred gradient
whatItIs: A vivid blurred orange-to-purple gradient background with a large frosted-glass rounded rectangle panel at centre holding a bold 'GRADIENT BACKGROUND' title, a subtitle and placeholder body text.
whatItMeans: Warm and premium; a frosted panel over a rich sunset-toned gradient gives any headline instant visual depth.
techniques: Blur a vivid multi-colour gradient for a soft, glowing backdrop.
Float a frosted glass panel at centre for content legibility.
Keep panel content minimal so the gradient stays the star.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent blurred rectangle mimicking textured glass.
